Container.Name: tailscale-ikev2-gateway
Container.Overview: IKEv2 VPN gateway into your Tailscale tailnet, for devices that can't run the Tailscale client. Connect with the built-in Windows VPN client (no extra software), split-tunnel only the Tailscale IP range (100.64.0.0/10) through it, and reach every node on your tailnet. Runs strongSwan + tailscaled in one container. Forward UDP 500 and 4500 on your router to this host.
Container.Description: A bridge between the standard IKEv2 VPN built into Windows (and macOS/iOS/Android) and your Tailscale tailnet. The container joins your tailnet as a node; VPN clients authenticate with username/password (EAP-MSCHAPv2) and their tailnet-bound traffic is NATed out through the tailscale interface. Set a Cloudflare DNS API token to get an automatic Let's Encrypt certificate (clients then need zero setup beyond adding the VPN connection); without one, a self-signed CA is generated in /data/pki that clients must trust once. Supports optional Cloudflare DDNS to keep your hostname pointed at your home IP. See the README for the two-line PowerShell client setup with split tunneling.

Config.Name: IKE Port
Config.Description: IKEv2 negotiation port. Forward UDP 500 on your router to this host.

Config.Name: NAT-T Port
Config.Description: IPsec NAT traversal port. Forward UDP 4500 on your router to this host.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Persists Tailscale node state, ACME certificates, and the self-signed PKI.

Config.Name: VPN Domain
Config.Description: Public hostname clients connect to (e.g. vpn.example.com). Must resolve to your home IP. Used as the certificate identity.

Config.Name: Tailscale Auth Key
Config.Description: Optional tailnet auth key (tskey-auth-...). If empty, check the container log on first start for an interactive login URL.

Config.Name: Tailscale Hostname
Config.Description: Name this node shows up as in your tailnet.

Config.Name: Cloudflare DNS API Token
Config.Description: Cloudflare API token with Zone:DNS:Edit for the VPN domain's zone. Enables an automatic Let's Encrypt certificate (recommended — Windows then needs no cert import). Leave empty to use a self-signed CA from /data/pki.

Config.Name: ACME Email
Config.Description: Optional email for the Let's Encrypt account.

Config.Name: Cloudflare DDNS
Config.Description: Set to 'true' to keep the VPN domain's A record updated with your current public IP (requires the Cloudflare token).

Config.Name: Allowed Subnets
Config.Description: Comma-separated subnets the tunnel carries. Default is the Tailscale range only (split tunnel). Add e.g. 192.168.1.0/24 to also expose your LAN.

Config.Name: Client IP Pool
Config.Description: Virtual IP range assigned to connected VPN clients.

Config.Name: Client DNS
Config.Description: Optional DNS server pushed to VPN clients. Set 100.100.100.100 for Tailscale MagicDNS names (this sends the client's DNS through the tunnel).

Config.Name: Extra VPN Users
Config.Description: Optional additional logins, comma separated: alice:password1,bob:password2
